scope: Publication configuration only; the frozen acquisition and analysis artifacts remain unchanged.
exclusions: All raw original dataset values, document text, private inputs, reference text, labels, prediction text, model response text, and gold text are excluded regardless of license.
All raw data, input, original, gold, reference, prediction, response, and labels caches and dumps are excluded; unlisted files and nested paths in evidence/qd-real and prototype/qd are excluded.
Dataset-linked identifiers may be published only as hashes or aggregate IDs; no dataset values may be published.
Allowlisted artifacts are limited to public metadata, plans, code, hashes, aggregate IDs, and aggregate diagnostic summaries; filenames do not authorize excluded content.
Existing builder exclusions, cache/bytecode exclusions, substitutions, and post-sanitization hash recomputation remain in effect.
